title: Build the Workshop Before the Software Factory — Armin Ronacher, Earendil
summary: Earendil's Pi coding agent has the same core tools it had a year ago, yet it does far more because the models got better. Armin Ronacher shows his own session data: fewer corrections, tasks running 14 minutes instead of two and a half, and 141 projects started but only 10 to 15 kept alive.
